name: Ghost Cafe
note: Synthetic fixture (tests only — never a live API result, never a real place). In fakeFetch's ghost mode, the first candidate's /v2/places response for catering.cafe includes this competitor, and /v2/place-details?id=ghost-1&features=details returns a closed marker (properties.closed === true). The ghost filter must move it out of the competitor count into ScoutResult.unconfirmed with reason 'unconfirmed — verify on foot', and drop it from the candidate's pois before scoring.
closed_marker_contract: A Place Details result counts as closed/delisted when ANY of these holds: properties.closed === true; properties.status is 'closed' or 'delisted'; properties.datasource.raw.permanently_closed === true. (The real Geoapify closed representation is undocumented — this fixture defines the contract.) An empty features array or a 404 from Place Details also counts as unconfirmed. Any other Place Details failure (network, 429) does NOT unconfirm — the POI stays counted and a limitation is added instead.
